senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) thing given in charge, deposit.
units: Gen. R. s. 93, beg. לית שמיה פקדון אלא פּוּק דּוֹן (some ed. פוקדון in one word) it ought not to be called piḳḳadon, but puḳ don (go out of this, avoid it; דון for דין).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 5:1">Shebu. V, 1</cite> <he>שבועת הפ׳</he> the oath concerning a deposit.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 5:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>תן לי פִקְדּוֹנִי</he> give me my deposit back.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:7">Ib. VI, 7</cite> <he>מי שהפ׳ אצלו</he> the trustee.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:2">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 5:12">Num. V, 12</cite> <he>ומעלה בו מעל</he>, a.

Lev. V, 21) לפי שהיא כופרת בפ׳ because she betrays a trust; מה ממון הקל כל הכופר בפ׳ … בפִקְדּוֹן גוף וכ׳ if in money matters which are of slighter import, he who denies a deposit is considered like denying the Lord, how much more so is one who denies the deposit of a body (purity of the family)! Tanḥ. Shof’ṭim 12 פ׳ אחד … תן לו פִּקְדּוֹנוֹ וכ׳ one deposit has he (the Lord) with thee, give it back to him and make thyself a god; ומה פקדונו וכ׳ and what is his deposit? Said she, the soul within thee; a. v. fr.—Pl. פִּקְדּוֹנוֹת, פִּיקְ׳. Gen. R. l. c. ברח מן הפ׳ flee from receiving trusts; Yeb. 109ᵃ.—בעל פ׳ trustee.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:5">Gen. R. s. 53</cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 43:1">Pesik. R. s. 43</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01449"><he>פָּקַד</he></cite>; a. e.
